title: 第九章 乱兵第十章 恃险若平地
content_zh:
画眉河穿山过岭来到画眉山脚下，汇入九源江。
四明县就在江河交汇之处，这里水运发达，小小码头上停靠了不少中小货船。
船只上的硬帆都有自家标识，周无纪经常来四明县，对这些颇为熟悉。
他一眼就在众多船只中看到了李家的商船，船帆上写着大大“万丰”。
万丰号，正是李家的商号。专门向外贩卖山苍子油，利润颇丰。
画眉山四明群山向外突出的一部分，直插入九源江，也就此改变了九源江的流向。
四明群山物产丰富，盛产各种草药。其中最出名就是山仓子。
李家先人掌握了提炼山苍子油的技术，就此发家，成为四明县大族。
李家一群人正在忙碌的装货，万丰号二掌柜李信就站在码头上指挥吆喝。
这中年男子穿着件葛布长衫，头戴幞头，留着八字胡，很是成熟干练的样子。
周无纪提着小箱子慢悠悠走过去，他笑着招呼：“李二掌柜……”
“呦、是周道长、”李信一抬头看到了周无纪，也不由怔了下。
几个月没见，周无纪怎么变了个人似的。尤其是一双眸子晶亮温润，整个人都显得异常精神。
李信很快反应过来，他赔笑着过来招呼，“您这么早过来、是有事？”
“嗯，我要去云阳府一趟。”
周无纪拿出一块玉牌递给李信，“我和如意说了，麻烦二掌柜带我一程。”
李信双手接过玉牌，见正是自家小姐的东西，他连连点头赔笑：“您要坐船说一声就行。有您在船上坐镇，我们心里都特别安稳，这是我们求之不得的。”
“有点急事，咱们要尽快走，没问题吧。”周无纪要是搭顺风船，自然不需要和李如意说。
但他不敢耽搁时间，就要李家的货船配合他才行。
“没问题，货也装好了。装好口粮、淡水就走。”李信也看出周无纪是有些着急，也不敢耽搁。

就算没有小姐的玉牌，藏龙观观主亲传弟子，在四明县也是有头有脸的人物。他可不敢得罪。
船提前走一会，也不过是船夫、伙计辛苦一些，不算什么。
在李信的张罗下，船很快拔锚启航。
这艘货船船型修长，艏艉尖细，船身低矮，俗称鸟船，意为小巧又速度极快。
货船就三间船舱，二掌柜把最大舱室给了周无纪。
说是最大，舱内也不过方圆丈许，勉强放一张木床和一张小桌。
舱壁、木桌、木床都贴着黄色符纸，朱红符文写的分明是金光咒。
世上妖魔鬼怪多不胜数，每个人都会带着护身法符。
行船更是危险，船上各处都要贴满法符。
周无纪对此非常了解，事实上售卖法符是道观极其重要的收入。
他把黄金放在床下面，坐在床上看着窗外岸边风景，清爽晨风一吹，也是浑身轻松惬意，船舱内那股子阴湿腐气也就不算什么了。
昨晚上一直没睡，周无纪看了一会没发现异常，就关窗睡觉休息了。
到了中午，二掌柜李信端着餐盘过来送饭。
content_en:
Thrush River passes through mountains and ridges to the foot of Thrush Mountain and merges into Jiuyuan River.
Siming County is at the intersection of rivers. Water transportation here is developed, and many small and medium-sized cargo ships are docked at the small wharf.
The hard sails on the ships all have their own logos. Zhou Wuji often comes to Siming County and is quite familiar with these.
He saw the Li family's merchant ship among the many ships at a glance, with "Wanfeng" written in large letters on the sail.
Wanfenghao is the business name of the Li family. Specializing in selling Litsea cubeba oil to foreign countries, the profits are huge.
The protruding part of the Siming Mountains in Huamei Mountain plunges directly into the Jiuyuan River, thus changing the flow direction of the Jiuyuan River.
The mountains of Siming are rich in natural resources and are rich in various medicinal herbs. The most famous among them is Shancangzi.
The ancestors of the Li family mastered the technology of refining Litsea cubeba oil and made a fortune, becoming a wealthy family in Siming County.
A group of people from the Li family were busy loading goods, and Li Xin, the second shopkeeper of Wanfeng, stood on the dock giving orders.
This middle-aged man wears a Gebu gown, a bun on his head, and a mustache. He looks very mature and capable.
Zhou Wuji walked over slowly carrying a small box. He greeted with a smile: "Shopkeeper Li Er..."
"Hey, it's Daozhang Zhou." Li Xin looked up and saw Zhou Wuji, and couldn't help but be startled.
After not seeing each other for several months, Zhou Wuji seemed to be a different person. In particular, his eyes were bright and warm, and his whole person seemed extremely energetic.
Li Xin reacted quickly. He smiled apologetically and came over to say hello, "You came here so early. Do you have something to do?"
"Well, I want to go to Yunyang Mansion."
Zhou Wuji took out a jade plaque and handed it to Li Xin, "I told Ruyi, please give me a ride, the second shopkeeper."
Li Xin took the jade plaque with both hands and saw that it belonged to his own lady. He nodded and smiled in apology: "You can just tell me when you want to take the boat. With you on board, we feel very at ease. This is what we want."
"It's a little urgent. We have to leave as soon as possible. It's okay." If Zhou Wuji was just taking a free ride, he naturally didn't need to talk to Li Ruyi.
But he didn't dare to waste time, so he needed the Li family's cargo ship to cooperate with him.
"No problem, the goods are packed. Just pack the rations and fresh water and leave." Li Xin also saw that Zhou Wuji was a little anxious and did not dare to delay.
Even without the lady's jade plaque, the direct disciple of the master of Hidden Dragon Temple is still a prominent figure in Siming County. He didn't dare to offend.
If the boat leaves a little early, it just means the boatman and crew have to work harder, it’s nothing.
With Li Xin's help, the ship quickly pulled anchor and set sail.
This cargo ship has a slender shape, a tapered bow and stern, and a low hull. It is commonly known as a bird ship, which means small and extremely fast.
The cargo ship only had three cabins, and the second shopkeeper gave the largest cabin to Zhou Wuji.
It was said to be the largest, but the cabin was only about ten feet in diameter, with barely room for a wooden bed and a small table.
The bulkheads, wooden tables, and wooden beds are all covered with yellow talisman paper, and the vermilion runes clearly read the Golden Light Spell.
There are countless monsters and ghosts in the world, and everyone carries amulets.
Sailing on a boat is even more dangerous, as talismans must be posted everywhere on the boat.
Zhou Wuji knew this very well. In fact, selling talismans was an extremely important income for the Taoist temple.
He put the gold under the bed, sat on the bed and looked out the window at the scenery on the shore. The refreshing morning breeze made his whole body feel relaxed and comfortable, and the damp and rotten smell in the cabin was nothing.
He didn't sleep last night. Zhou Wuji looked at it for a while and found nothing unusual, so he closed the window and went to sleep.
At noon, the second shopkeeper Li Xin came over with a dinner plate to deliver the food.
